Postman suddenly required creating an account to their cloud... I got annoyed so bad that deleted that piece of cr*p immediately. Then I found Bruno and fell in love. Thanks for the great work!
So I turned to Bruno. I have been happy with it but there are some strange issues. Sometimes it does not save settings when I press Ctrl s... I lost some work a couple of times because of this.
I've noticed this same save issue in Bruno. The fix for me: cmd+s only works if the left pane (Query, Body, etc) has focus. Save does not work if the right pane (Response, Headers, etc) has focus
